records.title: Codex 0.154.0 release
records.decision: Use the installed stable CLI's documented app-server interfaces; keep model settings unchanged and distinguish managed-socket recovery from stdio success.

records.title: Codex App Server
records.decision: Use initialization, read-only task listing and paginated turns; avoid inventing private endpoints or treating an empty summary as a clear guard.

records.title: MCP lifecycle
records.decision: Treat protocol initialization and capability negotiation as prerequisites; reconnect before dependent calls.

records.title: PowerShell quoting
records.decision: Use literal file arguments and structured JSON, preserving process handles instead of interpolating untrusted text into shell commands.

records.title: Node VM
records.decision: A VM context is not a security boundary. Only locally authored trusted simulation code is evaluated.

records.title: Epic MassGameplay
records.decision: Separate entity data, behavior and visual representation; use small scripted entities now.

records.title: Epic StateTree
records.decision: Use explicit states and transitions as an architectural comparison; no Unreal installation or compatibility claim.

records.title: Google Agent Engine sessions
records.decision: A persisted session is a technical state container, not an identity continuity claim. Cloud execution remains outside this local simulation.

records.title: Claude tool use
records.decision: Keep typed tool schemas and results distinct from model text; the current NPCs remain scripted without provider calls.

records.title: W3C VC Data Model 2.0
records.decision: Credential structure and verification are distinct from truth, reliance policy and legitimate authority. Current consent flags are synthetic.
